english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an act or instance of nominating someone for an award or position.
Use this for a nomination for an award, position, or other honor.

examples.english: He finally received a nomination for Best Actor.
examples.traditional: 佢終於獲得最佳男主角提名。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 wok6 dak1 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 tai4 ming4

examples.english: They got a nod for Best Actor this year.
examples.traditional: 佢今年攞到最佳男主角提名。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 gam1 nin4 lo2 dou2 zeoi3 gaai1 naam4 zyu2 gok3 tai4 ming4
